summary: display: grid turns an element into a grid. grid-template-columns sets the columns, gap sets the space between cells, and grid-column lets one item cover more than one column.
notes: repeat(3, 1fr) is short for 1fr 1fr 1fr: three columns that split the width equally.
Items fill the grid left to right, then start a new row. You do not have to place each one.
grid-column: span 2 makes the featured card two columns wide, so only one more card fits in the first row.
pitfall: Writing grid-template-columns: 3; and expecting three columns. It needs a size for each column, like repeat(3, 1fr).
